_doc: Drawing facts for build_harness.py that the wire list does not hold (labels, title, notes). Wires, pins, descriptions, colours, ident bands and end notes come from the wire list.
title: ST185-ECU-cabin - ECU harness, cabin side (ECU plugs A, B, C to the bulkhead)
rev_note: loom A and loom B merged into one ECU harness (Dan 2026-10-19, DECISIONS R220); built from the master wire list (R201).

connectors.ecu_a: ECU-A  Link G4X plug A (centre dash)
connectors.ix_ws_front_p: FRONT WS INLINE  to front VR conditioner

splices.sp_8v: ECU splice point - SP-8V: +8 V cam sensor supply (ECU A6)
splices.sp_trig2: At the ECU plugs - SP-CAM: cam signal + 1.8k pull-up to +8V
splices.sp_a5: ECU splice point - SP-A5: ECU main feed (SW12 + IG2 diode)
splices.sp_sw12: ECU splice point - SP-SW12: switched +12 V (LOGIC SW12)
splices.sp_shield_a: 6 mm behind the ECU-A plug - SP-SHIELD-A: drains to A7
splices.sp_ac_psw: At A/C amp - SP-AC-PSW: A/C pressure switch output
splices.sp_gnd_ecu: ECU splice point - SP-GND-ECU: ECU power ground (A25 A34 B25 B34) to the NEG bar
splices.sp_shield_b: 6 mm behind the ECU-B plug - SP-SHIELD-B: drains to B17

general_notes: Each table is a pinout: pin, wire, description. A wire has the same description at both ends.
An end that says 'on ST185-<file>' is the same wire running on in that loom, not a join.
Every shield drain is its own wire. Drains meet only at SP-SHIELD-A, 6 mm behind the ECU-A plug: the crank drain is crimped into A7, the others are soldered onto it.
Sensor ground (ECU A24) never joins chassis ground or loom B sensor ground (ECU B22).
Bulkhead pins marked N/C are section B (see ST185-ECU-cabin) or spares with a sealing plug.
